published_ranges._notes: TDS (wiki.kingroon.com, V1.0, 2025/12/1): nozzles 0.2-0.8, Engineering/High Temp/Textured PEI plate, fan on, HDT 1.8MPa 84C, Tg N/A. Chamber 45-60C implies an enclosed printer. Retraction/print-speed/chamber label mapping inferred from the flattened PDF layout (value order matches the other Kingroon V1.0 TDS sheets: retraction length, retraction speed, chamber temp, overhang, bridging ... printing speed). (ABS sheet values 20-40 mm/s and <300 mm/s are unlabelled in the extraction.) Product page not re-read this run. Earlier entry: TDS V1.0: Engineering Plate / High Temperature Plate / Textured PEI with glue; HDT 1.8 MPa 84 C; PC+ABS spool rated 90 C. kingroon.com handle says 'abs-carbon-fiber' but the product is plain ABS in solid colours. Verification 2026-11-01: fields and plate/chamber/fan/retraction ranges confirmed against the TDS PDF; kingroon.com / kingroon3d.com product pages returned HTTP 429, so page-derived notes and conflicts were not re-checked.
